div.head: II Cn 40.1
div.ab: ⁊ bete man þæm cingce, swa hit gebyrige, oððe he ða dæde wrece swiþe deope.
⁊ bete man þam cynincge, swa hit gebyrige, oððe he þa dada wrece swyðe deope.
Et emendetur regi, sicut iustum est, aut ipsum (uel illud) factum nimis profunde uindicet.
⁊ beton ðam kyninge swa hit gebyrige, oððe he ða dæde wrece swyðe deope.
And bete man þam cingce, swa hit gebyrige, oððe he ða dæde wrece swiþe deope.
und büsse man dem König, wie es sich gebührt, oder dieser strafe die That sehr hoch.
and let compensation be paid to the king as is fitting, or let him avenge the deed very severely.
And such compensation as is fitting shall be paid to the king, or he shall avenge the deed to the uttermost.
And compensation is to be paid to the king, as is fitting, or he is to avenge the deed very severely.
And appropriate compensation shall be paid to the king, or he shall avenge that deed most severely.
